chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn 'Aidh, from Ibn Abi Udhaynah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The two praises, together: the praise of Saba and the praise of Fatir. Whoever recites them at night will remain under Allah's protection and guardianship that night. And whoever recites them during the day will not be affected by anything unpleasant that day, and will be granted from the goodness of this world and the goodness of the Hereafter that which has not occurred to his heart nor reached his desires.

key_terms.حَمْدَانِ: The two praises (referring to Surah Saba and Surah Fatir)

ai.seo_question: What are the virtues of reciting Surah Saba and Surah Fatir?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the unique spiritual efficacy of reciting Surah Saba and Surah Fatir, distinguishing their benefits by time of day: night recitation ensures divine protection (hifz) and guardianship, while day recitation wards off misfortunes and grants abundant worldly and otherworldly blessings. This practice reflects the Shia tradition of linking specific Quranic chapters to distinct temporal spiritual states, emphasizing the transformative power of the Quran in daily life.
